info.title: Rivet REST API
info.description: Rivet v1 status, domain reads and backend player sessions. No web UI. Application keys managed only through the physical console. Loopback HTTP requires HTTPS reverse proxy for remote access.

applicationKey.description: Console-issued application key. Never put a permanent key in browser JavaScript or query strings.

total.description: -1 while saved-region discovery is running; final visited slots after completion.

TerrainSlice.description: Inclusive cave search band, 4–256 blocks. Absent on surface/isometric. Only enclosed floors with at least two air blocks beneath an opaque roof inside this band are rendered.
